launch_planning.description: The master defines scope, child roster, success criteria, and allowed child job shapes before any child launches.
master_responsibilities: write the initial canonical durable record

child_execution.description: Children execute bounded slices and return evidence packets, but they do not integrate or redefine fanout truth.
master_responsibilities: launch children under one parent-owned run
track child status from durable records
enforce that child output stays evidence-only

collection.description: The master collects child outputs, decides whether more repair/finishing is needed, and keeps the authoritative roster and status view.
master_responsibilities: decide whether partial child output needs tightening
preserve the canonical child roster and status map

integration.description: The master alone integrates candidate outputs into one parent decision surface and records the integration disposition.
master_responsibilities: preserve fail-closed handling for nonclean child results

final_verification.description: The master evaluates the integrated result and chooses the parent verdict without delegating that authority to children.

terminal_reporting.description: The scheduler or reporting surface publishes the master-owned terminal summary without replacing the underlying durable record.
master_responsibilities: render the operator-visible summary from durable parent truth
preserve the final verdict and stage in receipts
keep prompts and summaries explanatory only

forbidden_child_claims.integrator_owner: Children may not claim integrator ownership; the master remains the sole integrator.
forbidden_child_claims.integration_disposition: Children may not publish the parent integration disposition.
forbidden_child_claims.final_verdict: Children may not assign the fanout verdict.
forbidden_child_claims.operator_summary_state: Children may not publish the operator-facing terminal summary state.
forbidden_child_claims.child_roster: Children may not redefine the roster or status truth of sibling children.
forbidden_child_claims.fanout_stage: Children may not redefine the canonical parent lifecycle stage.
